item.jojomod.stand_arrow.tooltip: Right click: the arrow pierces you. Only the worthy awaken a Stand.
item.jojomod.stone_mask.tooltip: Wear it as a helmet and press V to become a vampire.
item.jojomod.stone_mask.tooltip2: Sneak + right click a villager or hostile mob to turn it into a vampire.
item.jojomod.red_stone_of_aja.tooltip: Use as a vampire wearing the Stone Mask: sunlight no longer burns you.
item.jojomod.sunscreen.tooltip: Vampires are immune to sunlight for 2 minutes.
item.jojomod.rokakaka.tooltip: Eat it to lose your Stand and be able to get a new one.
ability.jojomod.star_platinum.c2.desc: Piercing finger strike in a line.
ability.jojomod.star_platinum.q1.desc: Night vision and highlights nearby hostiles.
ability.jojomod.star_platinum.q2.desc: Pulls nearby dropped items to you.
ability.jojomod.star_platinum.p1.desc: Chance to catch projectiles aimed at you.
ability.jojomod.the_world.c3.desc: Leap and slam down, damaging everyone around.
ability.jojomod.the_world.c5.desc: A devastating barrage of 20 heavy punches.
ability.jojomod.the_world.q1.desc: Speed III and Jump Boost for 30 seconds.
ability.jojomod.the_world.p2.desc: Regeneration when your health is low.
ability.jojomod.crazy_diamond.c2.desc: A heavy punch that sends the target flying.
ability.jojomod.crazy_diamond.c3.desc: Shatters the ground around you, damaging and slowing enemies.
ability.jojomod.crazy_diamond.c4.desc: Heals you and allies, damages nearby hostiles.
ability.jojomod.crazy_diamond.c5.desc: Huge barrage that heals you at the end.
ability.jojomod.crazy_diamond.q1.desc: Fully heals you or the target and cleanses bad effects.
ability.jojomod.crazy_diamond.q2.desc: Repairs every damaged item you carry.
ability.jojomod.crazy_diamond.p2.desc: Your held items and armor slowly repair themselves.
ability.jojomod.killer_queen.c1.desc: Touch a target to arm it. Use on nothing to detonate all.
ability.jojomod.killer_queen.c2.desc: Automatically blows up nearby hostile mobs for 9 seconds.
ability.jojomod.killer_queen.c4.desc: Blows up all hostile mobs around you in sequence.
ability.jojomod.killer_queen.c5.desc: For 90s, if a mob explosion would hit you (or you die by one), time rewinds ~10s.
ability.jojomod.killer_queen.q1.desc: Digs a 3x3 tunnel ahead of you.
ability.jojomod.killer_queen.q2.desc: Blasts you into the air with slow falling.
ability.jojomod.gold_experience.c1.desc: Overloads the target with life energy: damage, slowness, nausea.
ability.jojomod.gold_experience.c2.desc: A bolt of life energy that pierces enemies in a line.
ability.jojomod.gold_experience.c4.desc: Hurts hostile mobs and regenerates allies around you.
ability.jojomod.gold_experience.c5.desc: Nullifies the target: massive damage, slowness, weakness, blindness.
ability.jojomod.gold_experience.q1.desc: Grows nearby crops and heals you.
ability.jojomod.gold_experience.p2.desc: Attackers take damage and get nauseous.
ability.jojomod.magicians_red.c1.desc: A cone of flames in front of you.
ability.jojomod.magicians_red.c2.desc: A ring of fire around you; you gain fire resistance.
ability.jojomod.magicians_red.c4.desc: A huge cone of fire with long range.
ability.jojomod.magicians_red.c5.desc: Engulfs everything around you in flames.
ability.jojomod.magicians_red.q1.desc: Cooks the raw food in your inventory.
ability.jojomod.magicians_red.p1.desc: You are immune to fire and lava.
ability.jojomod.magicians_red.p2.desc: Your punches set targets on fire.
ability.jojomod.hamon.overdrive.desc: A Hamon-charged punch. Devastating against undead and vampires.
ability.jojomod.hamon.zoom_punch.desc: Extends your arm to hit from afar.
ability.jojomod.hamon.sendo_kick.desc: A Hamon shockwave kick in front of you.
ability.jojomod.vampire.drain.desc: Bite a victim to restore blood and health.
ability.jojomod.vampire.eyes.desc: Eye beams that ricochet to nearby targets. (2 blood)
ability.jojomod.vampire.flesh_bud.desc: Turns a zombie into a loyal ghoul. (4 blood)
quest.jojomod.0.title: Courage Against the Dead
quest.jojomod.0.desc: Defeat 10 undead monsters (zombies, skeletons...). Then come back to me.
quest.jojomod.1.title: Breathing Training
quest.jojomod.1.desc: Hold Shift to breathe deeply for a total of 90 seconds.
quest.jojomod.2.title: Offering to the Sun
quest.jojomod.3.title: The Hunt Continues
quest.jojomod.4.title: Master of the Waves
quest.jojomod.4.desc: Spend a total of 60 seconds in water, learning to breathe with the current.
msg.jojomod.ability_locked: §cThis ability is locked. Unlock it in the skill tree (J).
msg.jojomod.aja_already: §cYou already carry the power of the Red Stone.
msg.jojomod.aja_need: §cYou must be a vampire wearing the Stone Mask.
msg.jojomod.aja_used: §c§lThe Red Stone of Aja fuses with the mask... the sun can no longer harm you!
msg.jojomod.already_ghoul: §cThat zombie is already one of yours.
msg.jojomod.arrow_rejected: §4The arrow rejected you. You were not worthy...
msg.jojomod.btd_armed: §4Bites the Dust is armed for 90 seconds.
msg.jojomod.need_mask: §cWear the Stone Mask on your head first.
msg.jojomod.no_energy: §cNot enough energy! Hold Shift to breathe. %s
msg.jojomod.no_stand: §cYou have no Stand. Use a Stand Arrow!
msg.jojomod.rokakaka_nothing: §7Tastes terrible, but you had no Stand.
msg.jojomod.rokakaka_used: §6Your Stand left your body. You can awaken a new one with an Arrow.
msg.jojomod.stand_help: §7Z = summon, ALT + scroll = wheel, R = use, J = status/skill tree.
msg.jojomod.stat_max: §7This attribute is already at max level.
msg.jojomod.sun_burn: §cThe sun burns your skin! Find shade or use sunscreen.
msg.jojomod.too_weak: §cYou are too weak to survive the arrow!
msg.jojomod.vampire_on: §4§lThe spikes pierce your skull... you abandoned humanity! (V = back to human)
msg.jojomod.water_walk_on: §bYou can walk on water for 30 seconds!
msg.jojomod.zeppeli_done: §e<Zeppeli> You have mastered everything I could teach. Go, and protect the world!
msg.jojomod.zeppeli_new_quest: §e<Zeppeli> Listen well, young one. Your trial: §6%s
msg.jojomod.zeppeli_next: §e<Zeppeli> Come back when you are ready for the next lesson.
msg.jojomod.zeppeli_not_yet: §e<Zeppeli> You are not ready yet. Keep training!
msg.jojomod.zeppeli_vampire: §c<Zeppeli> I smell the stench of the undead on you! Begone, creature!
gui.jojomod.title: JoJo Status
gui.jojomod.vampire_none: Human. Stone Mask + V to transform.
gui.jojomod.vampire_ready: Mask equipped! Press V to transform.
gui.jojomod.vampire_buff: Str II, Speed I, Jump II, Res I, Night Vision, 25% lifesteal
gui.jojomod.aja_yes: Red Stone of Aja: immune to sunlight
gui.jojomod.aja_no: Burns in sunlight (even with a helmet)
gui.jojomod.tree_help: Click a node to spend XP

advancement.jojomod.battle_tendency.desc: Complete Zeppeli's first trial and learn Hamon.
advancement.jojomod.stardust_crusaders.d: Awaken a Stand with the Stand Arrow.
advancement.jojomod.diamond_is_unbreakab: Unlock the 5th combat ability of a Stand.
advancement.jojomod.golden_wind.title: Golden Wind
advancement.jojomod.golden_wind.desc: Eat a Rokakaka and let go of your Stand.

advancement.jojomod.steel_ball_run.desc: Complete all of Zeppeli's Hamon trials.
